Side-parted dark hair, one upper-lip moustache with a visibly bare chin, and exactly one restrained closed mouth below it are retained; there is no chinstrap/jaw beard and no second upper lip. Olive closed collar with paired gold tabs, gold shoulder details/buttons and the diagonal strap remain recognizable. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk, pinching or cream bib. Full white/cyan comparisons show no working-matte halo, interior holes or see-through clothing.
